metadata.description: Positive employment and self-employment income fall by the selected share, and the same weighted total goes to positive capital income: long- and short-term capital gains, taxable interest, qualified and non-qualified dividends, and rental income. We scale every positive amount by one common factor, so each person gains in proportion to the capital income they already receive, and losses stay as they are. We simulate current law with no behavioral responses.

decile_impacts.methodology: Households are bucketed into deciles by baseline weighted market income. Each household's decile membership is fixed at baseline across all shift scenarios, so the chart tracks how the same groups move with the experiment.

health_tanf_programs.unfunded: CHIP policyengine-us books for people whose immigration status fails the federal test, in states with no undocumented_immigrant rule, apart from the unborn-child option; and Medicare Savings Program benefits for people whose status fails the federal test
